title: Dream Scenario And The Reality We Create

commenti.body: Dreamfluencers did get a chuckle from me--but stroke of genius? Futurama did the same joke twenty years ago to better effect. Honestly, that segment of the movie felt sorely out of place. Not to mention, it compromised the metaphysical stakes at play. It was more interesting when the phenomenon of Paul's dream appearances were fully unexplained. But if there were a readily discoverable biological mechanism behind it that capitalists could find a way to immediately exploit--for me, that spoils the magic. Unless the implication is that the Norio bracelet was pure snake oil, but from what we see in the movie, it seems to work.
